arrive.text: The desert. You've been walking since dawn, and your water ran out hours ago.

mirage.text: It was a mirage. Only hot air, bending the blue of the sky down onto the sand.

ask.text: But there's a rock, just here.

water.text: And under the rock: water. There was water here all along.

end.text: You believed there was water here, and there was. But what you saw was a mirage, not the water. Did you know it was here?

back_1.text: You give up on it, and turn back.

back_idle.text: You rest a while, then turn back.

back_2.text: You'll never know it. But you were right. There was water here, under a rock, a step away.
